name: Wikipedia
description: Reads article summaries and outlines, extracts sections, and searches the current Wikipedia language edition.

tools.name: get_wikipedia_article_overview
tools.description: Return the current article's title, description, lead paragraphs, language, and canonical URL.

tools.name: get_wikipedia_article_outline
tools.description: Return the current article's section hierarchy and stable section IDs.

tools.name: get_wikipedia_section
tools.description: Return the visible text for one section of the current article.

tools.name: search_wikipedia
tools.description: Search the current Wikipedia language edition and return matching article titles and snippets.
